title: Appointed as Assistant
original: Umm, excuse me… I've been waiting here... for two hours…

title: Talk 1
original: Sorry… I know people keep ignoring me... But... my Arts aren't to blame…

title: Talk 2
original: My Arts... make me undetectable to people... in certain environments…

title: Talk 3
original: I… I've never had any friends... S-surely no one wants a friend that…  they can't even notice… right?

title: Talk after Promotion 1
original: My tail... It curls up when I'm not fighting... So please, don't be afraid…

title: Talk after Promotion 2
original: Doctor... you can leave the dangerous work to me... After all... my Arts were made for that…

title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
original: These ID tags around my neck… I collected them... I like holding onto evidence... that someone once existed...

title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
original: Don't let that 'Nightmare' girl near me!... She's dangerous... My Arts don't work on her... Why…?

title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
original: I… I really want to cure my Oripathy. But if it's cured... what's going to happen to my Arts?... If they're gone, will I... still be of any use...?

title: Idle
original: Doctor's ignoring me… I don't like it, hmph...

title: Onboard
original: I'm Manticore... My Arts can take out lives silently... Please don't be scared, you're not my target…

title: Watching Battle Record
original: Thank you... I-I'm looking forward to you teaching me... more...

title: Promotion 1
original: Finally, I got a promotion... I always thought I wasn't good enough… so you didn't promote me…

title: Promotion 2
original: Did I... manage to help you? I don't have anywhere else to go... My home is here... at Rhodes Island... So please, let me protect it with you...

title: Added to Squad
original: Okay...

title: Appointed as Squad Leader
original: Nobody will like me... as their captain...

title: Depart
original: Please don't leave me behind…

title: Begin Operation
original: Please choose tactics that make use of my Arts... even if it's something crafty and underhanded... I won't mind...

title: Selecting Operator 1
original: I-I'm ready...

title: Selecting Operator 2
original: I'm…right here…

title: Deployment 1
original: Manticore… going dark…

title: Deployment 2
original: Ready... to ambush...

title: In Battle 1
original: That must... really hurt…

title: In Battle 2
original: Please, Don't come close…

title: In Battle 3
original: I don't like this... either...

title: In Battle 4
original: Farewell…

title: 4-star Result
original: Even in such terrible battles… your judgement and decisions didn't seem to waver… You're incredible, Doctor…

title: 3-star Result
original: A victory by all means... Still...

title: Sub 3-star Result
original: I can handle the runaways... if you wish...

title: Operation Failure
original: I'm sorry... It's all my fault...

title: Assigned to Facility
original: I'll sit... in the corner...

title: Tap
original: Eeeeeek!

title: Trust Tap
original: Thank you for paying attention to me... I know it's your job... but it still makes me happy…

title: Title
original: Arknights.

title: New Year's blessing
original: Happy New Year... More people have  noticed me... in the last year... I'm a little scared, but... a lot of them are very warm, and kind... So, I'm going to try as hard as I can... to adapt...

title: Greeting
original: Hello... Doctor...

title: Birthday
original: I'll just put the present on the table and leave... Doctor, happy birthday... Eek! Did-did you notice me...? Um, Happy birthday to you... Doctor.

title: Anniversary Celebration
original: I don't want to go through the experience... of losing a friend again... I will defend everyone, with my own life. Even if it's somewhere none of them will see me...
